parts.t: Neighbourhood guides · City of Surrey

These guides cover Surrey north of the South Surrey and Cloverdale areas: North Surrey, Guildford, Fleetwood and Newton. Each one covers schools, parks, City plans and what to check before you buy, with a source next to each fact.
Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty. Updated October 14, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate since 2015.
Seven areas north of about 96 Avenue, from the Fraser River and SkyTrain to Guildford and Fraser Heights. The guides follow MLS® sub-area names, which are not City boundaries.

FAQ
Which Surrey areas have a guide?

Fourteen. North Surrey: Bridgeview, Bolivar Heights, Whalley, Cedar Hills, Royal Heights, Guildford and Fraser Heights. Fleetwood, Newton and central Surrey: Queen Mary Park Surrey, Bear Creek Green Timbers, Fleetwood Tynehead, West Newton, East Newton, Panorama Ridge and Sullivan Station. Each one follows its MLS® sub-area name.
Where are South Surrey, White Rock and Cloverdale?
They have their own guide pages:
South Surrey and White Rock neighbourhood guides
and
Cloverdale neighbourhood guides
Do these areas have official boundaries?
No. They are MLS® sub-area names, not City of Surrey boundaries, and the City’s plan areas often use different lines. Each guide gives the edges as approximate and says where an edge is not clear.
